en: And like my introspection is that the ambition comes from, you know, the if you like a really simple thing, right?

en: And a big part actually of while building the company that I feel like I've come to understand but also resolve and calm down is that one thing that I've like actually told people at work is that a lot of people think you should build from a place of lack.
zh: 在创建公司的过程中,有一件我觉得自己已经理解了、而且已经化解并平静下来的事情,实际上我对工作中的人说过,那就是很多人认为你应该从一个匮乏的状态出发去构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or like, you know, you have a chip on your shoulder, you need to prove something.
zh: 或者说,你知道,你心里憋着一股劲,你需要证明什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can definitely build great things that way, but I think you create a lot of damage along the way.
zh: 你确实可以用那种方式建造出伟大的东西,但我觉得你会在过程中造成很多伤害。

speaker: Unknown
en: And to me, I've decided to create from a place of wholeness.

en: So I'm like, I don't need anything.

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm not trying to prove anything.

zh: 这就是为什么我经常谈到要玩得开心,或者说如何享受过程,因为这其实就是你的人生。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 否则的话,你就处在这样一种状态,你知道,脑子里像噩梦一样,试图证明某件事,同时在世界上做那么多事情。

en: And I think it felt empty.
zh: 我觉得那感觉很空虚。

en: So I kind of realized that at the end, there's nothing at the end of success.
zh: 所以我有点意识到,在终点,成功之后什么都没有。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's nothing on that other side that I'm chasing and that it actually is just right now.
zh: 在我所追逐的那一边,什么都没有,而它其实就在当下。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, how do I feel right now?

speaker: Unknown
en: Why am I doing it?

en: But I was willing to take that risk because it felt more honest to me.

en: I think my top commitment is to reality, which I think is a helpful commitment if you're an entrepreneur.

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to see what life is actually like and what is actually happening.

speaker: Unknown
en: And I committed to that and I was like, I'll go wherever that path goes.

en: Tell me about that.

speaker: Unknown
en: So to me, that kind of feels like the Freudian death wish where you're just like imagining something that is not here, that is going to happen in the future and you're always there.
zh: 所以对我来说，那感觉就像是弗洛伊德式的死亡愿望，你就是在想象某个不在此刻、将来才会发生的东西，而你总是在那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I instantly kind of had this felt experience of… It's a very Buddhist thought living in the present.
zh: 然后我立刻有了这种切身的体悟……活在当下是一个非常佛教的念头。

en: It is a very Buddhist thought.

en: Be calm with yourself.

en: It means you have clarity of mind for the ambition, for the future thinking, but what I experienced then was a felt experience of what it's like to actually be there and then being really grateful for the boredom where I'm like, oh wow, I'm so grateful to be bored because I'm here.

en: We'll get into that.

en: Yeah.

en: I find that I come in and out of it.

en: And so the practice is remembering it when you should be anxious or when something is going wrong.

en: Do you think a lot of people read you wrong that way?

zh: 我其实并不那么在意定价本身。

zh: 谈谈对此的反弹,谈谈你们做了什么,以及你们在这方面的理念。

en: I would say the backlash is minimal or at least we perceive it to be minimal.

en: Right.

zh: 我想我们做了一系列分析,比如对一些相关内容的情感分析,然后我们发现大概 70% 是中性的,你懂,有一些负面的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I think all the people that were quite negative or loud about it had some self-interest.
zh: 所以我认为那些对此相当负面或者闹得很响的人,都有某种自身利益。

zh: 而且我们当时规模已经足够大，觉得自己知名度也够高，可以把它拆成两个维度，然后让用户清楚地知道自己在哪一部分付了什么钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also make it cheaper.

speaker: Unknown
en: Because sometimes you just need to grease it and then it keeps going.

en: Oh, so you don't hop on where the momentum's hot.

speaker: Unknown
en: Now we use this in all of our, and you know, people initially were like, alpha, that sounds like really nerdy, you know.

speaker: Unknown
en: Customers are nerdy.

speaker: Unknown
en: Right.

speaker: Unknown
en: Or just like, it's too finite.
zh: 或者就是说,它太有限了。

en: And I'm like, people will get it from finance.
zh: 我就说,懂金融的人会明白的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we have a couple of these things where every once in a while there's one idea that generates momentum.
zh: 所以我们有几个这样的东西,每隔一段时间就会有一个点子能产生势头。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll give you another idea.
zh: 我再举一个例子。

en: We needed a feature that we call audiences which allows you to have a concept of a company or a person in the product so that you can aggregate signals on it.
zh: 我们需要一个我们称之为 audiences 的功能,它让你能在产品里有一个公司或人的概念,这样你就可以在上面聚合信号。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's backed by a CRM.
zh: 而且它由一个 CRM 支撑。

en: So we're not building a CRM, it's backed by that.
zh: 所以我们不是在自建 CRM,而是由它来支撑。

speaker: Unknown
en: But to get that going in the company was incredibly challenging.
zh: 但要让这个在公司里推进起来极具挑战性。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, people are like, what about our tables?
zh: 你知道,人们会说,那我们的表怎么办?

en: Well, like, we don't want this to have table limits, no roll limits, no cell size limit, a lot of the limits that we just remove it.
zh: 嗯,比如说,我们不想要这个东西有表数量限制、没有行数限制、没有单元格大小限制,很多限制我们直接去掉。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I had to motivate it in a different way.
zh: 所以我不得不用另一种方式来推动它。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wasn't getting traction, which is kind of interesting.
zh: 它原本没有获得进展,这挺有意思的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it was, I had to motivate it by saying, okay, we need signals, which is, we already have data, we need data changing over time.
zh: 但后来,我不得不这样推动它:好,我们需要信号,也就是,我们已经有数据了,我们需要随时间变化的数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so let's build signals.
zh: 所以我们来构建信号。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was okay.
zh: 这样就通了。

speaker: Unknown
en: People got that.
zh: 大家理解了这个。

en: And we then were selling signals and we started beating companies that only sold like job changer signals.

en: Then the team themselves realized, well, what if you have five signals?
zh: 然后团队自己意识到,那如果你有五个信号呢?

en: What are you going to aggregate it out?
zh: 你要怎么把它聚合出来?

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, you need this concept of an audience, which we were talking about before.
zh: 嗯,你就需要 audience 这个概念,也就是我们之前一直在说的那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that, like, you know, I think it's kind of, again, the storytelling.
zh: 而这个,你知道,我觉得还是那回事,讲故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I should have been telling that story before, but like leading the team so that they believe themselves and they have the momentum is very different than me being like, you need to build this feature.
zh: 我本应该更早讲那个故事的,但带领团队让他们自己相信、让他们拥有势头,和我直接说“你们需要做这个功能”是完全不同的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one of the things I think you realize, CEO, is that you are sometimes way ahead of everybody else because you're getting input from so many places, not just because you're smarter or whatever it is, but you're just getting your purview is larger.
zh: 所以我想你会意识到的一件事是,作为 CEO,你有时候远远领先于其他人,因为你从那么多地方获取输入,不是因为你更聪明或者别的什么,而是因为你的视野范围更大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's all you're thinking about all day.
zh: 而且这就是你一整天在想的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you have an intuition for this that you've built over time because I've made a huge number of mistakes everywhere, but I've also been doing this for so long.
zh: 而你对这个有一种随着时间建立起来的直觉,因为我在方方面面犯过大量的错误,但我也做这件事做了太久了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.

en: Momentum Detective.

speaker: Unknown
en: I love that.

speaker: Unknown
en: Right.

speaker: Unknown
en: I appreciate your coming on.
zh: 感谢你来参加节目。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a wonderful conversation.
zh: 这是一次很棒的对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Congrats on all your success.
zh: 祝贺你取得的所有成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hey, everybody.
zh: 嘿,各位。

speaker: Unknown
en: I hope you liked that episode with Kareem.
zh: 希望你们喜欢这期和 Kareem 的节目。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really enjoyed the conversation.
zh: 我真的很享受这次对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a lot of takeaways.
zh: 我有很多收获。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to give you my three, and I'm going to give you a couple stories of my own that tie in.
zh: 我要给你我的三点,再讲几个我自己的、与之相关的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Two nights ago, I had dinner with Kareem and David Solomon from Goldman Sachs and Tarek, the CEO of Kalshi.
zh: 两天前的晚上,我和高盛的 Kareem 和 David Solomon,以及 Kalshi 的 CEO Tarek 一起吃了晚饭。

speaker: Unknown
en: And my takeaway from the dinner was, holy crap, are these three homo sapiens different?
zh: 这顿晚饭给我的感受是,天哪,这三个人也太不一样了吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: And holy crap, is their CEO playbook different?
zh: 而且天哪,他们的 CEO 打法也完全不同?

speaker: Unknown
en: And it reminds me of an old quote.
zh: 这让我想起一句老话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it goes, be yourself, everyone else is taken.
zh: 大意是:做你自己,因为其他人都已经被别人做了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it was Oscar Wilde who said it.
zh: 我记得是 Oscar Wilde 说的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I leave that with you.
zh: 我把这句话留给你。

speaker: Unknown
en: I hope you can be yourself because everyone else is taken.
zh: 希望你能做你自己,因为其他人都已经被别人做了。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a lot of ways to do this.
zh: 做成这件事有很多种方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm trying to look for the one way.
zh: 我一直在寻找那唯一的一种方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: The truth is there's a lot of ways to be successful as the CEO.
zh: 事实是,作为 CEO,通往成功的方式有很多种。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second thing, he's sort of a philosopher and he reminded me of something I've been working on.
zh: 第二点,他有点像个哲学家,他让我想起了我一直在琢磨的一件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And people say folks who live in the past tend to kind of be depressed and folks who live in the future tend to be anxious and folks who live in today seem to be a little bit happier.
zh: 人们说,活在过去的人往往容易抑郁,活在未来的人往往容易焦虑,而活在当下的人似乎会更快乐一些。

speaker: Unknown
en: I myself tend to live in the future and I'm kind of anxious.
zh: 我自己就倾向于活在未来,所以我有点焦虑。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember when my anxiety peaked, and this may be happening to you, so I relay it.
zh: 我记得我的焦虑达到顶峰的时刻,如果你也正在经历,我就分享给你。

speaker: Unknown
en: I remember doing a company meeting around 100, 150 employees and just looking out and seeing, oh my gosh, there's so many people relying on me to make really good decisions.
zh: 我记得在公司大约 100、150 人的时候开全员会,我环顾四周,心想,天哪,有这么多人指望我做出非常好的决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're taking care of their kids, they're paying their mortgages, they're taking care of their parents in a lot of cases.
zh: 他们要养孩子,要还房贷,很多时候还要照顾父母。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wasn't actually in the tough times at the beginning.
zh: 其实焦虑并不是在最初艰难的阶段出现的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was when we were actually scaling and starting to do pretty well that my anxiety increased.
zh: 反而是当我们开始扩张、做得还不错的时候,我的焦虑才增加了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anyway, if that's you, this is just a reminder.
zh: 总之,如果你也是这样,这只是个提醒。

speaker: Unknown
en: Living in the present is a good place to be.
zh: 活在当下是一个好的状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm trying to do more of that myself.
zh: 我自己也在努力更多做到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Kareem gave me a really good reminder of that.
zh: Kareem 给了我一个很好的提醒。

speaker: Unknown
en: The third thing is I like his line, devotion versus discipline.
zh: 第三点,我喜欢他那句话:热爱投入(de devotion)与自律纪律(discipline)之分。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's really hard to scale a startup without real devotion from your employees.
zh: 如果没有员工发自内心的热爱投入,一家初创公司真的很难规模化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And your vision and your story has to be really compelling.
zh: 而你的愿景和你的故事必须非常有说服力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if it's not, you should work on that.
zh: 如果不是,你就应该去打磨它。

speaker: Unknown
en: You yourself need to be really compelling.
zh: 你自己也需要非常有感染力。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to inspire followership.
zh: 你需要激发人们的追随。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want people to want to kind of walk across broken glass to work for you.
zh: 你要让人们心甘情愿地为你赴汤蹈火。

speaker: Unknown
en: And like your company probably has stuff hanging on the walls, you know, slogans and things you come up with, your culture code stuff.
zh: 你的公司墙上大概也挂着一些东西,你知道,口号,还有你们想出来的各种标语,你们的文化准则之类。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's incredibly important that you don't just talk to talk, but actually walk the walk on those slogans on the wall.
zh: 非常重要的一点是,你不能只是嘴上说说,而是要真正践行墙上那些口号。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll leave you those three.
zh: 这三点我留给你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hope you liked it.
zh: 希望你喜欢。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really enjoyed him.
zh: 我真的很欣赏他。

speaker: Unknown
en: See you next time.
zh: 下次见。
